title: should / would / could / must have
recall: Perfect modal'lar: o'tmish haqida taxmin va afsusni qanday aytasiz? 4 ta tuzilmani misol bilan ayt.
formula: must / might / can't have + V3: o'tmish haqida taxmin — He must have forgotten
should / shouldn't have + V3: afsus, tanqid — You should have told me
could have + V3: imkoniyat bor edi, lekin bo'lmadi; would have + V3: shart bajarilganda bo'lardi

en: You should have told me.
He must have forgotten.
She must have forgotten.
I should have studied more.

items.uz: Sen bunchalik ko'p yemasliging kerak edi.
en: You shouldn't have eaten so much.
We could have won.
If I had known, I would have helped.
I would have helped if I had known.
He must have missed the train.
She must have missed the train.

items.uz: U buni qilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas — u shu yerda edi.
en: He can't have done it — he was here.
He couldn't have done it, he was here.
They might have got lost.
They may have got lost.
They might have gotten lost.
You're late! You could have taken a taxi.
You're late! You could have got a taxi.

items.uz: Men u gapni aytmasligim kerak edi.
en: I shouldn't have said that.
I must have left my keys on the bus.

items.uz: Sen yiqilib tushishing mumkin edi — ehtiyot bo'l!
en: You could have fallen — be careful!
You could have fallen, be careful!
She might not have seen the message.
She may not have seen the message.
We should have left earlier.

items.uz: Men senga qo'ng'iroq qilardim, lekin telefonim o'chgan edi.
en: I would have called you, but my phone was dead.
I would have phoned you, but my phone was off.

items.uz: U juda qimmat to'lagan bo'lsa kerak.
en: He must have paid a lot.
She must have paid a lot.

items.uz: Sen kelmaganing yaxshi bo'ldi — zerikarli edi. (kelishing shart emas edi)
en: You needn't have come — it was boring.
You didn't need to come, it was boring.

items.uz: U imtihondan o'tolmagan bo'lishi mumkin emas — u a'lochi.
en: He can't have failed the exam — he's a top student.
She can't have failed the exam, she's an excellent student.
You shouldn't have done that!

speak: Hayotingizdagi 3 ta afsus: I should have / shouldn't have.
Do'stingiz kechikdi — 4 xil taxmin (must have / might have / can't have).
Agar boshqacha qilganingizda nima bo'lardi? (would / could have)
